metadata.modifications: Removed plotting, close/clc and iteration logging, instrumented maximum-iteration exits, and printed 12 significant digits. No physics, force ramp, solver tolerances, initial coordinates or time step were changed.
metadata.sampling: Zero-based probe node 19 (the 20th of 40) is recorded every 1 ms. All 40 nodes are recorded at step 1, every 25 steps through 200, every 100 steps thereafter, and the final step.
metadata.original_solver: Newton tolerance 1e-4, maximum_iter 10 (the source can exit after the 11th iteration); browser solver uses tolerance 1e-7 and line search.
